name: SK Discovery Co., Ltd.
summary: SK Discovery Co., Ltd. is a diversified enterprise operating globally and domestically in South Korea through its subsidiaries. The company's operations span several key sectors: it develops and supplies environmentally conscious materials, including biomaterials, advanced composites, high-performance substances, and energy-saving solutions. Furthermore, it delivers comprehensive healthcare offerings, ranging from vaccines and pharmaceuticals to patient treatment, prevention, and diagnostic services. SK Discovery is also active in the energy and chemicals domain, engaging in LPG storage, tank terminal services, and power generation. Its real estate division focuses on developing commercial properties, office buildings, urban and luxury residences, and renewable energy infrastructure such as solar and wind power facilities. Founded in 1969 and headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea, the company was formerly known as SK Chemicals Co., Ltd. before rebranding to SK Discovery Co., Ltd. in December 2017.
